title: Unrestricted strict-henselization stalk formula
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $F$ be an abelian etale sheaf on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and let $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Put $S_{(\bar x)}=\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{S,\bar x}$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], and let $p:X\times_S S_{(\bar x)}\to X$ be the projection [def-pc-fibre-product]. For every $q\geq0$, the canonical restriction map $(R^q f_*F)_{\bar x}\to H^q((X\times_S S_{(\bar x)})_{\mathrm{Et}},p^{-1}F)$ is an isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].

proof.text: Apply existsUnique_strictHenselizationStalkRestriction from [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-restriction] to G = H^q(Rf_*(F[0])). Obtain its canonical germ restriction r and the representative-neighbourhood restriction equations.
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-germ-restriction-iso] to G and r with those equations. This proves IsIso r without a torsion assumption.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-unrestricted-strict-henselization-stalk-comparison] and compose its invertible comparison with the invertible germ restriction. Supply the restriction equations and the composite isomorphism to the existential conclusion.

lean.statement: theorem unrestricted_strictHenselization_stalk {X S : Scheme.{w}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] {Ω : Type w} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (xbar : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{w + 1}) (q : ℕ) : ∃ r : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale xbar).sheafFiber.obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).obj ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{w + 1} f).obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F))) ⟶ (Sheaf.Γ (Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme xbar).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{w + 1}).obj ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{w + 1} (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap xbar)).obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).obj ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{w + 1} f).obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))), IsStrictHenselizationStalkRestriction xbar ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).obj ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{w + 1} f).obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F))) r ∧ IsIso (r ≫ strictHenselizationCohomologyComparison xbar f F q)
lean.note: The canonical map is the germ restriction r characterized by IsStrictHenselizationStalkRestriction, followed by the already-landed strictHenselizationCohomologyComparison; existence and uniqueness of r are already stated in StrictHenselizationRestriction.
